# Radial separates requested actions from learned Mac shortcuts


By OpenTools Team


Version 5.3.0 distinguishes command‑bar requests, learning‑based suggestions and shortcut‑building hints.


##


Request an action


Radial’s[October 30 release](https://radial.appverge.net/changelog) adds Ask Radial, a command bar opened with Option‑Space. The publisher says it carries out plain‑language requests and can add the result to a menu. An immediate request can thus become a shortcut the user keeps.


##


Let suggestions accumulate


Made for You can instead learn Mac use over several days, then proposes shortcuts or app menus. The notes say learning can be switched off and erased. Separately, Smart Suggestions supplies names, icons and actions while a shortcut is built, without requiring AI Pro. Radial already offered AI actions before this release.


Original explanatory diagram: requested actions and learned suggestions are separate Radial workflows; this is not its interface.
